Its editorial update does not establish a date-specific firsthand gay-male cruising visit. Its public visiting hours are not authoritative confirmed (Waze displays 06:00-20:00; park directory explicitly does NOT verify hours). Preserve access caveat; distinguish park from similarly named Fort Washington Park in Maryland.
